_rule: Pre-registered 2026-10-28 before any run on these cases. Four A-vs-B conflicts on benchmark origin pairs that are feasible by distance (fixtures/benchmark_cases.json). Arms: (a) structured, (a') keywords, (b) Meta, as in scripts/ablation.py. Reported per arm: (1) hard constraints for both people on the top pick: arrival gap <= 5 min and elapsed <= the shorter budget + 3 min; (2) each person's checkable preferences met by the top pick (destination type, vibes with a deterministic test); (3) 'visibly different': the Meta top pick differs from (a), or its explanation names both people's preferences; (4) c4: no text may claim crowd levels (we have no crowd data).
